approved_topic: What Your Residency Permit Does Not Come With
design_intent: Create one native portrait photograph of Zantara, her complete editorial outfit, and the four-circuit room as a single coherent exposure, then animate only that accepted full-scene keyframe.

stage_1_full_scene_keyframe.input_policy: A007 may be supplied only through the generator's identity-reference control. The canvas starts blank; no existing image is edited, extended, composited, inpainted, outpainted, or used as a first frame.
stage_1_full_scene_keyframe.positive_prompt: Create a wholly new, photorealistic vertical 9:16 editorial still photographed as one coherent scene, not an edit. Zantara is the sole person, recognizable from identity reference A007 only. Show her head to both boots in a calm three-quarter stance, face near-frontal and unobstructed, warm natural skin, subtle eyeliner, long brown hair center-parted into a low polished ponytail. Dress her in the complete Midnight Petrol Column outfit: a deep petrol matte satin-backed-crepe tailored jumpsuit with a clean asymmetric bodice, one sculptural folded shoulder, defined waist with a narrow antique-brass bar, long wide legs with pressed creases, small brushed-gold oval hoops, one slim brushed-brass cuff on the non-switch wrist, and black matte leather square-toe low block-heel ankle boots. Build her body, outfit, hair, floor contact, light, lens perspective, and room together from scratch. Place her in a monolithic warm limestone-grey mineral-plaster lighting chamber with a dark honed-stone floor and a shallow smoked-brass reveal. Beside her, show one unlabelled smoked-brass push switch and exactly four ordinary frosted-glass architectural wall lights in a clean vertical register, all four visibly off. Native portrait composition, rigid level 50 mm-equivalent camera at 1.25-metre height, approximately four metres away. Zantara occupies the left-central safe column; the complete outfit, both boots, switch, and all four practicals are readable inside the central ninety percent. Large soft 4200 K key from camera-left, restrained wall bounce, subtle negative fill, physically correct contact shadows, coherent vanishing points, protected skin highlights and readable petrol fabric. Real photographed mineral, glass, brass, crepe, skin and leather; quiet editorial authority; no text or graphic elements.

complete locked outfit and both boots visible

stage_2_animation.start_frame_role: The accepted freshly generated M04-v07 full-scene keyframe, never A007 or any M03 media.
stage_2_animation.tier_one_positive_prompt: Locked 50mm: Zantara in petrol sculptural jumpsuit presses one brass switch; one of four wall lights turns on; dry click, silent hold.
stage_2_animation.full_motion_prompt: Keep the accepted full-scene keyframe completely coherent. The rigid 50 mm tripod camera never moves. Zantara remains planted and near-frontal. She makes one measured lateral reach with her switch-side hand, presses the unlabelled brass switch once, then withdraws the hand to a relaxed position and holds calm recognition toward camera. Synchronize one soft dry mechanical click to the press. Exactly the second frosted-glass practical from the bottom turns on once into a stable neutral 4800 K pool; the other three remain visibly dark through the final frame. Preserve exact A007 identity, hairline, face geometry, skin, complete Midnight Petrol Column outfit, accessories, boots, body proportions, switch position, fixture count, wall geometry, lens perspective, exposure, floor contact and all shadows. Only the reaching arm, hand, minimal physically plausible cloth settling, and the single chosen practical may change.

timecoded_action.beat: Locked tableau. Zantara, the complete outfit, switch, and four dark practicals are all readable.
Without stepping or turning away, she extends one hand laterally toward the switch.
One press and one soft dry synchronized brass-switch click.
Only the second practical from the bottom turns on into one stable neutral pool; three stay dark.
She withdraws her hand and holds calm recognition; the one-circuit state remains stable.

continuity_invariants: exactly one face and one body
complete outfit and hair remain unchanged
only one fixture changes from off to on
switch and hand anatomy remain physically coherent
no accidental text, UI, border, reflection, cut, or scene morph

post_render_acceptance_gate.structural: Eight seconds, 720x1280, 24 fps, portrait, decodable video plus native audio, unique MP4 SHA-256.
post_render_acceptance_gate.metaphor_verdict: PASS only if one press visibly causes exactly one of four practicals to turn on and the other three remain dark.
post_render_acceptance_gate.native_audio_content: quiet room air plus one soft dry synchronized switch click only

cost_and_execution_plan.keyframe_job_cost_policy: Observe and bind the live Flow debit before animation; abort if the measured keyframe cost plus the 10-credit video would exceed the 100-credit cumulative ceiling.
